Table. *Data table 9 from *

Concept Font Symbols
Generic base ring Latin cap R — type variable in Lean ({R : Type*} with the weakest typeclass that admits the construction: [CommRing R], [Field R], [GroupWithZero R], etc.). Default for all categorical / algebraic / q-deformation / Wenzl–Hecke–Hoefsmit structural data.
Archimedean base ring blackboard bold \mathbb{R} (ℝ in Lean) — used only past the archimedean wall: any declaration that genuinely needs Real.sqrt, Real.rpow, Real.cos, Real.exp, Real.log, an ordering predicate (0 < q), linarith, or a CODATA / experimental numerical value. Narrative side: q \in R when only the algebraic structure matters; q \in \mathbb{R} only for archimedean evaluation (e.g. q_0 = 1.109978595642739\ldots (muon pin, 16 dps)).
